View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr in the Family-B dangling-Hold tracking sheet, since this flow intentionally stops at a held (uncommitted) state (Section 5.2/6.3). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- no enrichment flags required for this flow, but record them for reference -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Hold (send the same current ID pair (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; price-reconciliation IS script-enforced for V2 Hold, 2.10) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; re-validate price -- script-enforced in both versions, 2.12) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held, holdExpirationDate present and future; MANUAL price-reconciliation check -- V2 Retrieve not script-enforced) -- FLOW STOPS HERE by design (Family B); log pnr for cleanup/expiry tracking
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family B): bookingStatus reads a held (not yet ticketed) state with holdExpirationDate present and in the future at the final Retrieve -- the flow deliberately STOPS here (Family B, no BookAfterHold/CancelAfterHold), leaving a dangling Held booking; log the pnr for out-of-band cleanup/expiry tracking per SPEC.md Section 6.3. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.

Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Void) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking.
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- no enrichment flags required for this flow, but record them for reference -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Book (send (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=booked; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Void (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; ONLY expected to succeed if the Book response's voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed, 2.9/2.15; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided/cancelled)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family C): bookingStatus reads booked at Retrieve, then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed), and a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided/cancelled bookingStatus. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- no enrichment flags required for this flow, but record them for reference -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Hold (send (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; script-enforced price check) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held) -> BookAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR/gdsPnr, bookingToken -- no passenger data resent; capture pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR and ASSERT they are IDENTICAL to Hold's values, same-PNR invariant, 2.13; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus transitions held->booked/confirmed)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family D): bookingStatus transitions from held (after Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold) to booked/confirmed (after BookAfterHold), with pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR identical to the values Hold produced (same-PNR invariant, SPEC.md Section 2.13). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Hold, Void) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- no enrichment flags required for this flow, but record them for reference -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> BookAfterHold (ASSERT pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged from Hold) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held->booked) -> Void (send pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName/voidTickets=[]; gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed; follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family E): bookingStatus transitions held -> booked via BookAfterHold (same-PNR invariant holds) and then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability), with a follow-up manual Retrieve expected to show voided/cancelled. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Hold, CancelHold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr and confirm via a follow-up manual Retrieve that CancelAfterHold actually released the hold, since this endpoint has zero script coverage (Section 2.14). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- no enrichment flags required for this flow, but record them for reference -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> CancelAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; zero script coverage on this endpoint in either collection, 2.14; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- this is entirely manual/unscripted, treat as the weakest-validated endpoint in the API)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.
Actual Result
Failed checks: Retrieve after CancelAfterHold shows a cancelled/terminated state (got "OnHold"). capability flags recorded: canBeHeld=true haveBundles=false offerHasAncillary=false isSeatMapRequired=false | Hold price reconciliation (OK: all checks hold; total 13233.8 EGP): ok | PnrReprice price equals Hold price and reconciles: ok | Retrieve shows a held state with a future holdExpirationDate (bookingStatus "OnHold", 2026-10-30T21:59:00+02:00): ok | CancelAfterHold returns cancelled:true: ok | Retrieve after CancelAfterHold shows a cancelled/terminated state (got "OnHold"): FAILED

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking.
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Book (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = the most-current ID pair (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here -- V2 Book's script does not enforce it, 2.9/6.2) -> Retrieve (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; ASSERT bookingStatus=booked/confirmed, selectedOffer matches Book's; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here too -- V2 Retrieve has zero script assertions, 2.11/6.2)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family A): bookingStatus reads a booked/confirmed state at the final Retrieve, with selectedOffer.offerId/priceDetails.totalAmount matching between Book and Retrieve. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG).

Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Book (send (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=booked; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Void (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; ONLY expected to succeed if the Book response's voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed, 2.9/2.15; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided/cancelled)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family C): bookingStatus reads booked at Retrieve, then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed), and a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided/cancelled bookingStatus. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG).

Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = the most-current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here -- V2 Book's script does not enforce it, 2.9/6.2) -> Retrieve (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Ancillary, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr in the Family-B dangling-Hold tracking sheet, since this flow intentionally stops at a held (uncommitted) state (Section 5.2/6.3). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send the same current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; price-reconciliation IS script-enforced for V2 Hold, 2.10) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; re-validate price -- script-enforced in both versions, 2.12) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held, holdExpirationDate present and future; MANUAL price-reconciliation check -- V2 Retrieve not script-enforced) -- FLOW STOPS HERE by design (Family B); log pnr for cleanup/expiry tracking
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family B): bookingStatus reads a held (not yet ticketed) state with holdExpirationDate present and in the future at the final Retrieve -- the flow deliberately STOPS here (Family B, no BookAfterHold/CancelAfterHold), leaving a dangling Held booking; log the pnr for out-of-band cleanup/expiry tracking per SPEC.md Section 6.3. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Blocked: Ancillary enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01).
FLOW-V2-39 - Verify Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetAncillary -> FareCheck* -> Book -> Retrieve -> Void completes with a booked bookingStatus at Retrieve followed by a successful Void (gated by voidCapability); and selected ancillaries correctly reflected in passengersSelectedAncillaries/paxTotalAncillaryAmount.BLOCKED

Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Ancillary, Hold, CancelHold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr and confirm via a follow-up manual Retrieve that CancelAfterHold actually released the hold, since this endpoint has zero script coverage (Section 2.14). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> CancelAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; zero script coverage on this endpoint in either collection, 2.14; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- this is entirely manual/unscripted, treat as the weakest-validated endpoint in the API)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Blocked: Ancillary enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01).
FLOW-V2-43 - Verify Search -> FareConfirm -> GetOfferBundles -> AddPassenger -> GetAncillary -> FareCheck* -> Book -> Retrieve completes with a booked/confirmed bookingStatus at the final Retrieve, matching Book's selectedOffer/price; and bundle pricing correctly reflected without double-charging included services; selected ancillaries correctly reflected in passengersSelectedAncillaries/paxTotalAncillaryAmount.BLOCKED
Endpoint Name: V2 flow
Request: Not run
Response: Not applicable
Expected: Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family A): bookingStatus reads a booked/confirmed state at the final Retrieve, with selectedOffer.offerId/priceDetails.totalAmount matching between Book and Retrie

Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, Ancillary) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking.
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = the most-current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here -- V2 Book's script does not enforce it, 2.9/6.2) -> Retrieve (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; ASSERT bookingStatus=booked/confirmed, selectedOffer matches Book's; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here too -- V2 Retrieve has zero script assertions, 2.11/6.2)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family A): bookingStatus reads a booked/confirmed state at the final Retrieve, with selectedOffer.offerId/priceDetails.totalAmount matching between Book and Retrieve. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle + Ancillary enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01).

Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family C): bookingStatus reads booked at Retrieve, then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed), and a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided/cancelled bookingStatus. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle + Ancillary enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01).

Preconditions

Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; script-enforced price check) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held) -> BookAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR/gdsPnr, bookingToken -- no passenger data resent; capture pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR and ASSERT they are IDENTICAL to Hold's values, same-PNR invariant, 2.13; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus transitions held->booked/confirmed)

Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (SeatMap) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking.
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = the most-current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here -- V2 Book's script does not enforce it, 2.9/6.2) -> Retrieve (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; ASSERT bookingStatus=booked/confirmed, selectedOffer matches Book's; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here too -- V2 Retrieve has zero script assertions, 2.11/6.2)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family A): bookingStatus reads a booked/confirmed state at the final Retrieve, with selectedOffer.offerId/priceDetails.totalAmount matching between Book and Retrieve. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).
FLOW-V2-50 - Verify Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap -> FareCheck* -> Hold -> FareConfirmAfterHold -> Retrieve completes with a held bookingStatus and a future holdExpirationDate at the final Retrieve (flow intentionally stops here -- dangling Held booking); and the chosen seat cellCode correctly reflected as a priced Seat-category line.BLOCKED

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (SeatMap, Hold, Void) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> BookAfterHold (ASSERT pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged from Hold) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held->booked) -> Void (send pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName/voidTickets=[]; gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed; follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family E): bookingStatus transitions held -> booked via BookAfterHold (same-PNR invariant holds) and then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability), with a follow-up manual Retrieve expected to show voided/cancelled. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).
FLOW-V2-54 - Verify Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap -> FareCheck* -> Hold -> FareConfirmAfterHold -> Retrieve -> CancelAfterHold completes with bookingStatus transitioning held -> cancelled/terminated via CancelAfterHold; and the chosen seat cellCode correctly reflected as a priced Seat-category line.BLOCKED

Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).

Preconditions

Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=booked; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Void (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, SeatMap, Hold, CancelHold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr and confirm via a follow-up manual Retrieve that CancelAfterHold actually released the hold, since this endpoint has zero script coverage (Section 2.14). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> CancelAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; zero script coverage on this endpoint in either collection, 2.14; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- this is entirely manual/unscripted, treat as the weakest-validated endpoint in the API)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).
