capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=booked; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Void (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; ONLY expected to succeed if the Book response's voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed, 2.9/2.15; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided/cancelled)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family C): bookingStatus reads booked at Retrieve, then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed), and a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided/cancelled bookingStatus. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: Ancillary + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).

Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: Ancillary + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).

if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=booked; MANUAL price-reconciliation check, V2 gap) -> Void (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; ONLY expected to succeed if the Book response's voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed, 2.9/2.15; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show voided/cancelled)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family C): bookingStatus reads booked at Retrieve, then Void succeeds (gated by voidCapability != VoidNotAllowed), and a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided/cancelled bookingStatus. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: Bundle + Ancillary + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG).

Bundle + Ancillary + SeatMap enrichment is required by this flow, and SabreNdc/EGY does not support it: Bundles are not offered (haveBundles=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-BUNDLE-NEG-01 in the Generic report and FLOW-V2-31-NEG); Ancillaries are not offered (offerHasAncillary=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetAncillary and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-ANCILLARY-NEG-01, TC-FARECHECK-NEG-01); Seat maps are not offered (isSeatMapRequired=false and offerHasSeat=false on all 91 offers (re-checked 2026-11-24); GetSeatMap and FareCheck answer 409 OperationNotSupported - see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01, FLOW-V2-49-NEG). | Round 1 verdict: BLOCKED (unchanged)
View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, Ancillary, SeatMap, Hold, CancelHold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr and confirm via a follow-up manual Retrieve that CancelAfterHold actually released the hold, since this endpoint has zero script coverage (Section 2.14). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> CancelAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; zero script coverage on this endpoint in either collection, 2.14; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- this is entirely manual/unscripted, treat as the weakest-validated endpoint in the API)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.

Preconditions
Supplier/credentialsSelector chosen and capability-confirmed per §4.7 for: Upsell. Collection variables reset/clean at flow start (§6.1). Non-production environment, or Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized if this flow reaches it.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> Book (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; manually verify price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a booked/confirmed state and selectedOffer matches Book's)
Expected Result
Booking confirmed: bookingStatus on Retrieve reflects a booked/confirmed state; selectedOffer.offerId and priceDetails.totalAmount match between Book and Retrieve; passengersList on Retrieve matches the AddPassenger submission. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier/credentialsSelector chosen and capability-confirmed per §4.7 for: Upsell, Void. Collection variables reset/clean at flow start (§6.1). Non-production environment, or Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized if this flow reaches it.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> Book (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; manually verify price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a booked/confirmed state and selectedOffer matches Book's) -> Void (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName; verify voidCapability allowed the action; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided bookingStatus)
Expected Result
Family-A checks apply through Retrieve, plus: Void succeeds only if the booking's voidCapability allowed it; a follow-up manual Retrieve shows a voided bookingStatus. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.

Preconditions
Supplier/credentialsSelector chosen and capability-confirmed per §4.7 for: Upsell, Hold. Collection variables reset/clean at flow start (§6.1). Non-production environment, or Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized if this flow reaches it.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> Hold (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; confirm {{Credentials_Selector}} resolves correctly given V2 Hold's known casing defect; manually verify price reconciliation per script; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify price reconciliation and that holdExpirationDate has not yet passed) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a held state, holdExpirationDate still future) -> BookAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify same-PNR invariant and price reconciliation; bookingStatus transitions to booked/confirmed) -> Retrieve (verify bookingStatus reflects booked/confirmed state, pnr unchanged from Hold)
Expected Result
Family-B checks apply through the first Retrieve, plus: BookAfterHold transitions bookingStatus from held to booked/confirmed; pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold (same-PNR invariant); the final Retrieve confirms the booked state. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier/credentialsSelector chosen and capability-confirmed per §4.7 for: Upsell, Hold, Void. Collection variables reset/clean at flow start (§6.1). Non-production environment, or Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized if this flow reaches it.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> Hold (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; confirm {{Credentials_Selector}} resolves correctly given V2 Hold's known casing defect; manually verify price reconciliation per script; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify price reconciliation and that holdExpirationDate has not yet passed) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a held state, holdExpirationDate still future) -> BookAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify same-PNR invariant and price reconciliation; bookingStatus transitions to booked/confirmed) -> Retrieve (verify bookingStatus reflects booked/confirmed state, pnr unchanged from Hold) -> Void (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName; verify voidCapability allowed the action on the now-finalized booking; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided bookingStatus)
Expected Result
Family-D checks apply, plus Family-C's Void checks applied to the now-finalized (ex-Held) booking. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.

Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> GetOfferBundles (consume substituted Upselling IDs; select a bundle code manually; IDs pass through unchanged; do not rely on JourneyKey1 for chaining - its resp.offerJourneys.key read is broken against the real response shape) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> Hold (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; confirm {{Credentials_Selector}} resolves correctly given V2 Hold's known casing defect; manually verify price reconciliation per script; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify price reconciliation and that holdExpirationDate has not yet passed) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a held state, holdExpirationDate still future) -> BookAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify same-PNR invariant and price reconciliation; bookingStatus transitions to booked/confirmed) -> Retrieve (verify bookingStatus reflects booked/confirmed state, pnr unchanged from Hold) -> Void (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName; verify voidCapability allowed the action on the now-finalized booking; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided bookingStatus)

submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> GetSeatMap (consume getAddPaxResponceID/getAddPaxOfferId; Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> GetOfferBundles (consume substituted Upselling IDs; select a bundle code manually; IDs pass through unchanged; do not rely on JourneyKey1 for chaining - its resp.offerJourneys.key read is broken against the real response shape) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> GetAncillary (consume getAddPaxResponceID/getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCresponseId, ANCofferId, isFareCheckRequired; assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty field name exactly as misspelled in the live response) -> GetSeatMap (consume getAddPaxResponceID/getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs auto-captured - manually record the chosen cellCode for Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries) -> FareCheck (only if isFareCheckRequired=true from the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap; consume ANCresponseId/ANCofferId; AncillaryCode copied verbatim from GetAncillary - never hand-constructed; overwrites fareConfirmSelectedOfferId and sets fareCheckOfferId; verify which responseId Book/Hold actually need afterward, given the commented-out propagation line) -> Hold (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; confirm {{Credentials_Selector}} resolves correctly given V2 Hold's known casing defect; manually verify price reconciliation per script; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify price reconciliation and that holdExpirationDate has not yet passed) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a held state, holdExpirationDate still future) -> BookAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify same-PNR invariant and price reconciliation; bookingStatus transitions to booked/confirmed) -> Retrieve (verify bookingStatus reflects booked/confirmed state, pnr unchanged from Hold)
Expected Result
Family-B checks apply through the first Retrieve, plus: BookAfterHold transitions bookingStatus from held to booked/confirmed; pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold (same-PNR invariant); the final Retrieve confirms the booked state. Bundle check: final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the chosen bundle's feePrice; bundle-included services are not also charged as separate ancillary lines. Ancillary check: passengersSelectedAncillaries lists exactly the codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity; paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of selected ancillary prices. SeatMap check: the chosen cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per GetSeatMap/FareCheck. FareCheck check: final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total, not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Same supplier/credentialsSelector capability-confirmation and variable-reset preconditions as FLOW-V2-25 (Section 4.7, 6.1). Tester deliberately introduces the described fault at the FareConfirm hop instead of the correct value/flag/timing.
Steps
  1. Run the positive chain up to and including FareConfirm (Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book -> Retrieve), then inject the fault at the FareConfirm hop as described: that FareConfirm rejects an ID/context pair whose supplier or credentialsSelector does not match the one used earlier in the same chain. Do not proceed past the point where rejection is expected; if the API unexpectedly accepts the faulted request, continue to the next step and record the resulting state as a defect.
Expected Result
UNKNOWN exact status -- confirm live. SPEC.md 1.7/3.2 treats supplier/credentialsSelector as a stateless per-call re-check, so a chain that switches supplier/credentialsSelector mid-flow while reusing IDs from the original supplier is expected to be rejected, not silently honored.

Preconditions
Same supplier/credentialsSelector capability-confirmation and variable-reset preconditions as FLOW-V2-31 (Section 4.7, 6.1). Tester deliberately introduces the described fault at the GetOfferBundles hop instead of the correct value/flag/timing.
Steps
  1. Run the positive chain up to and including GetOfferBundles (Search -> FareConfirm -> GetOfferBundles -> AddPassenger -> Book -> Retrieve), then inject the fault at the GetOfferBundles hop as described: that GetOfferBundles is rejected (or otherwise correctly refused) when called against an offer whose FareConfirm response reported haveBundles=false. Do not proceed past the point where rejection is expected; if the API unexpectedly accepts the faulted request, continue to the next step and record the resulting state as a defect.
Expected Result
Request is rejected or returns an empty/error bundleChoices; exact rejection shape is UNKNOWN per SPEC.md 2.4/3.2 -- confirm live. Calling a capability-gated step when the live gating flag is false must not silently succeed as if the offer were bundle-capable.
Actual Result
FareConfirm haveBundles=false; GetOfferBundles -> 409 code=OperationNotSupported msg="This action is not currently supported by the selected supplier." ctx=[{"Name":"OperationNotSupported","Value":"SabreNdc does not exists"}]. Rejected with the uniform OperationNotSupported envelope (SPEC 2.4 recorded the same for TravelportNdc); the call does not silently succeed.

View Test Case
Preconditions
A prior Hold established a valid pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken.
Steps
  1. Run V2 CancelAfterHold exactly as saved (credentialsSelector value not wrapped in quotes) -> observe request substitution and result
Expected Result
After Postman variable substitution, the body renders as `"credentialsSelector" : UAE,` - a bare unquoted token - which is invalid JSON; the request is expected to fail at the JSON-parsing layer (client-side send error or a server-side parse-error response), not merely an authorization failure. This is a literal syntax bug in the saved request body, not a business-logic inference (§2.14).
Actual Result
Invalid JSON rejected at the parser: 400 code=1001 msg="Validation errors occurred. Please check your request." ctx=[{"name":"cancelAfterHoldRequestDto","value":"The cancelAfterHoldRequestDto field is required."},{"name":"$.credentialsSelector","
TC-VOID-NEG-01 - Verify whether a hardcoded empty gdsPNR breaks Void for GDS-routed suppliers.PASS
Endpoint Name: Void with an empty GDS reference
Request: Booked, then voided with the GDS reference left blank
Response: Void succeeded
Expected: Whether the blank is accepted is recorded
Actual: Void with gdsPNR "" succeeded (200 voided=true) for SabreNdc, a GDS-routed supplier; Book's gdsPNR (RZHCQL) equals its pnr (RZHCQL), so Sabre needs no separate GDS PNR
Status: PASS
Evidence

View Test Case
Preconditions
A prior Book/BookAfterHold produced a real gdsPNR for a GDS-routed supplier (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, or TravelportNDC).
Steps
  1. Book/BookAfterHold with a GDS-routed supplier (capture the real gdsPNR) -> Void (submit gdsPNR="" literally, as the saved example does, instead of the real captured value)
Expected Result
Confirm live whether Void succeeds or fails when gdsPNR is sent as a literal empty string for a supplier whose booking actually requires a GDS PNR. The one working example in the collection is for AirArabia (LCC, not GDS-routed) and did not need it - record whether this is a supplier-type-dependent required field for GDS suppliers specifically (§2.15).
Actual Result
Void with gdsPNR "" succeeded (200 voided=true) for SabreNdc, a GDS-routed supplier; Book's gdsPNR (RZHCQL) equals its pnr (RZHCQL), so Sabre needs no separate GDS PNR
